source: Merged by the agent from the product owner's modelle-4 Meshy AI models (GitHub release modelle-4, Oct 2026): the stylized 3D close-up head (Meshy_AI_CharacterHeadCloseUpU_...glb) placed on the stylized full body (Meshy_AI_Curly_Confidence_...glb) by tools/meshy/merge4.py styl: head scaled and aligned on chin/nose/nasion, one tilted neck cut above the chains, neck bent onto the body's, one closed surface (voxel remesh), 160k triangles with the face and hands kept dense, new UVs with the face enlarged, base colour and normal map baked from the full-resolution sources. Face retouch after the PO's reference photos: lips toned to brown, light shadows under the eyes; the body's skin lifted to the head's tone. Game copy reduced by tools/meshy/reduce.py (120k triangles, base colour 4096, normal 2048) and rigged by tools/meshy/skin.py. The trousers' monogram is the PO's own '99' design.
